title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: please update your lead... yesterday was in fact the third time since March that Christopher Ilitch spoke with local media and the second time during the regular season - June 15 at Riley Greene introductory press conference. Thanks! When Detroit Tigers president and CEO Christopher Ilitch spoke to reporters for the first time this regular season on Friday afternoon, the first person he mentioned by name was manager Ron Gardenhire.
